title: centaurium erythraea subsp. suffruticosum
intro: Centaurium erythraea subsp. suffruticosum, commonly known as dwarf centaury, is a subspecies of the Centaurium erythraea plant, which is a perennial herb belonging to the gentian family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and fever, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium erythraea subsp. suffruticosum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, glycosides, and iridoids, which provide its medicinal properties.
